repository.name: awesome-lrm-unlearning
repository.title: Awesome LRM Unlearning
repository.subtitle: A curated collection of papers, benchmarks, datasets, evaluation metrics, and open-source frameworks for Machine Unlearning in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Reasoning.

categories.title: 1. Parameter-Update LRM & CoT Unlearning
categories.description: Training-time unlearning algorithms that update model weights or hidden-state representations to erase forget-set knowledge from both intermediate Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectories and final answers, via representation misdirection, mechanism-guided subspace targeting, counterfactual reasoning preference optimization, or guided reasoning distillation.

categories.title: 2. Inference-Time & Training-Free Trajectory Regulation
categories.description: Parameter-preserving interventions that monitor, steer, truncate-and-regenerate, or self-correct multi-step reasoning traces during decoding to prevent sensitive CoT disclosure while completely avoiding weight-induced reasoning collapse.

categories.title: 3. Benchmarks & Holistic Evaluation Suites
categories.description: Dedicated benchmarks and CoT-annotated datasets designed to measure step-level reasoning leakage, answer forgetting, multi-hop reasoning consistency, multimodal reasoning retention, and decoding-variant robustness.

categories.title: 4. Attacks, Vulnerabilities & Memorization Auditing
categories.description: Adversarial studies and construct-validity audits showing how step-by-step reasoning prompts extract superficially erased knowledge, how malicious unlearning requests manipulate LRM rationales, and how parser-split CoT audits can be confounded by template drift.

categories.title: 5. CoT Faithfulness via Reasoning-Step Unlearning
categories.description: Mechanistic frameworks that selectively unlearn individual verbalized CoT steps from model parameters to test whether generated reasoning chains faithfully reflect internal parametric computations.

news.content: Expanded after cross-checking arXiv, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, ACL Anthology, OpenReview, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, PAKDD, and related paper indexes: added nine LRM/CoT, agent-trajectory, multi-hop, and reasoning-aware audit works; refreshed formal venue and code links.
Initial repository release, with a taxonomy-structured reading list, chronological tracking, LRM-specific benchmarks, and CoT evaluation metrics.
**REDaCT** (*Findings of EMNLP 2026*) introduces collapse-free inference-time sentence-level leak detection and corrective embedding injection inside CoT traces.
**GUARD** proposes Guided Answer-Reasoning Distillation for natural safe-exit CoT trajectories and introduces the Natural Forgetting Reasoning Score (`NFRS`).
**CiPO** (*ACL 2026*) formulates causal counterfactual CoT preference optimization for LRMs; **R-MUSE / RMLLMU-Bench** (*CVPR 2026*) extends reasoning-preserving unlearning to Multimodal LRMs.

Landmark *EMNLP 2025* trio establishes the sub-field: **R-TOFU** (first LRM unlearning benchmark + `Reasoned IDK`), **R2MU** (reasoning-aware representation misdirection), and **FUR** (parametric CoT faithfulness via step unlearning).

papers.title: ShadowBench: Exposing Lexical Anchoring and the Illusion of Forgetting in Large Language Models
papers.summary: Defines the Latent Entity Leakage Rate (`LELR`) on name-free shadow prompts and shows that gradient-difference and NPO unlearning on Qwen3-8B still reconstruct the forbidden entity inside the reasoning trace.

papers.title: Reasoning-Aware Cross-Modal Association Unlearning in Multimodal Large Reasoning Models
papers.summary: Localizes a parameter edit to a designated visual-to-knowledge association and counterfactually rebinds intermediate reasoning, introducing CLEAR-R and MLLMU-R to measure reasoning leakage, hallucinated reassociation, and retained multimodal reasoning.

papers.title: REDaCT: Collapse-Free Unlearning in Large Reasoning Models
papers.summary: Detects forget-set leaks sentence-by-sentence inside CoT traces and injects an offline-learned corrective embedding to regenerate safe continuations with zero reasoning collapse.

papers.title: Mitigating Private Data Leakage in LLMs with Whiteout
papers.summary: Uses precise camouflage-data overwriting for private user-attribute associations and adds synthetic reasoning steps for reasoning models to suppress leakage while preserving reasoning utility.

papers.title: K-Bench: A Benchmark for LLM Unlearning in Agentic Deployments
papers.summary: Evaluates deployed ReAct agents across six observable channels and shows that suppressing final answers or CoT alone can leave secrets recoverable through tools, observations, retrieval, or summaries.

papers.title: GUARD: Natural Forgetting in Large Reasoning Models via Guided Answer-Reasoning Distillation
papers.summary: Converts unsafe or private CoT disclosures into natural safe-exit trajectories via guidance tokens and distills them into model parameters alongside the NFRS replacement-quality metric.

papers.title: Making LLMs Truly Forget: Deep Unlearning by Searching, Selecting, and Severing Knowledge Paths
papers.summary: Searches explicit and latent model-supported reasoning paths and applies confidence-aware minimum cuts to sever multi-hop recovery routes while preserving unrelated knowledge.

papers.title: Unlearning Deceptive Behaviors in LLMs with Contrastive Forget Sets
papers.summary: Builds contrastive forget units from realized deceptions and trains pressure-aware counterfactual reasoning targets that remove deceptive behavior while preserving context use and monitorable CoT traces.

papers.title: Trajectory Unlearning on LLM-based Agents
papers.summary: Defines trajectory-level unlearning for long-horizon agents and uses Group-injected Relative Policy Optimization to penalize undesired reasoning-action trajectories while preserving task utility.

papers.title: FedCoT-VQA: A Federated Learning and Unlearning Framework for Chain-of-Thought Planners in VideoQA
papers.summary: Introduces planner-side partitioning, deletion-ready aggregation, and residual unlearning to remove client influence from both federated parameters and CoT planner reasoning-trace behavior without full retraining.

papers.title: Test-Time Unlearning via Sparse Autoencoder
papers.summary: Freezes model weights and gates generation with a sparse-autoencoder forget detector, intervening only on triggered states so R-TOFU answers and intermediate CoT traces are suppressed together (`AFE`, `CFE`).

papers.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection
papers.summary: Uses token-level entropy and forbidden-token mass to delimit sensitive spans inside RL-trained multimodal reasoning traces, then redirects those spans with visual-anchor latent injection while leaving weights frozen.

papers.title: Leak-Resistant Unlearning: A New Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Hop Reasoning Consistency and Recovery Robustness
papers.summary: Evaluates whether unlearned knowledge remains recoverable across six logic-guided multi-hop reasoning structures combined with prompt-level and parameter-level recovery attacks.

papers.title: Disentangling the Effects of Unlearning in Measuring Parametric Faithfulness of Chain-of-Thought
papers.summary: Adds irrelevant-step and word-shuffle controls on top of step-level CoT unlearning, and defines `ΔIS` and `ΔWS` so parametric faithfulness scores subtract artifacts of the unlearning update itself.

papers.title: Mechanism-Guided Selective Unlearning for RLVR-Induced Reasoning
papers.summary: Identifies directional mismatch between SFT and RLVR reasoning updates, ranking attention-projection tensors by off-principal energy and forget-gradient coupling to unlearn target math reasoning without collapsing retain skills.

papers.title: Auditing Reasoning-Trace Memorization Claims after Unlearning with Head-Conditioned Canaries
papers.summary: Audits the parser-split CoT bypass gap on distilled LRMs using six-token canary heads, showing static tag-splitting conflates weight retention with template echo and format drift, and proposes decode-time prefill swaps plus teacher-forced scoring.

papers.title: CiPO: Counterfactual Unlearning for Large Reasoning Models through Iterative Preference Optimization
papers.summary: Formulates LRM unlearning via a causal graph and iteratively pairs self-generated counterfactual CoT-answer trajectories against online-sampled leaking traces using reference-free SimPO.

papers.title: Selective Forgetting for Large Reasoning Models
papers.summary: Uses RAG-assisted multi-LLM analysis to pinpoint forget-relevant segments within CoT traces, replacing them with logically consistent benign placeholders under a feature-replacement unlearning loss.

papers.title: Towards Unveiling Vulnerabilities of Large Reasoning Models in Machine Unlearning
papers.summary: Introduces white-box and black-box bi-level malicious unlearning requests that force unlearned LRMs to output incorrect answers supported by coherent, deceptive reasoning traces.

papers.title: The Unlearning Mirage: A Dynamic Framework for Evaluating LLM Unlearning
papers.summary: Dynamically generates semantically equivalent and multi-hop probes from pre-unlearning knowledge to expose recovery paths missed by static answer-level unlearning benchmarks.

papers.title: Explainable LLM Unlearning Through Reasoning
papers.summary: Constructs explicit reasoning-based unlearning targets specifying both unlearning scope and post-unlearning behavior, combining supervised reasoning loss with gradient ascent for explainable and attack-resilient forgetting.

papers.title: Harmonizing Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning with Reward-Based Sampling for Continual Machine Unlearning
papers.summary: Routes continual forget samples between gradient-ascent SFT and GRPO by reward. On ten sequential R-TOFU tasks with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, forgetting is scored with answer-level Model Utility (`MU`) and Forgetting Efficacy (`FE`) over full generations.

papers.title: STaR: Sensitive Trajectory Regulation for Unlearning in Large Reasoning Models
papers.summary: Parameter-free inference-time framework combining semantic sensitivity detection, global safety prompt prefixes, trajectory-aware suppression, and token-level adaptive filtering across diverse decoding modes.

papers.title: Robust LLM Unlearning via Post Judgment and Multi-round Thinking
papers.summary: Combines dynamic few-shot query cleaning, joint question-answer post-judgment, and selective multi-round thinking self-correction to defend deployed unlearning systems against prefix and composite reasoning attacks.

papers.title: DRAGON: Guard LLM Unlearning in Context via Negative Detection and Reasoning
papers.summary: Routes detected forget-worthy prompts without retain data through a dedicated Chain-of-Thought guard model that generates stepwise reasoning instructions for safe in-context unlearning and continual updates.

papers.title: Towards Reasoning-Preserving Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.summary: Introduces RMLLMU-Bench for Reasoning MLLMs alongside R-MUSE, a training-free subspace steering method that suppresses visual-textual CoT leakage while protecting a Reasoning Retain Subspace.

papers.title: Bits Leaked per Query: Information-Theoretic Bounds on Adversarial Attacks against LLMs
papers.summary: Defines leaked bits per query and quantifies how exposing logits or full thinking processes lowers the query complexity of attacks that recover information intended to be removed by unlearning.

papers.title: Reasoning or Retrieval? A Study of Answer Attribution on Large Reasoning Models
papers.summary: Combines memory unlearning with reinforcement learning to suppress retrieval shortcuts that compete with chain-of-thought reasoning and improve reasoning-dominant answer attribution.

papers.title: Rethinking Unlearning for Large Reasoning Models
papers.summary: Workshop formulation exposing persistent sensitive information leakage inside LRM thinking trajectories under conventional LLM unlearning and motivating reasoning-aware representation misdirection.

papers.title: Reasoning Model Unlearning: Forgetting Traces, Not Just Answers, While Preserving Reasoning Skills
papers.summary: First systematic study of LRM unlearning; proposes an 'unthinking' representation misdirection loss over elicited CoT segments paired with LIMO CoT representation alignment to preserve reasoning ability.

papers.title: Step-by-Step Reasoning Attack: Revealing 'Erased' Knowledge in Large Language Models
papers.summary: Demonstrates that step-by-step CoT reasoning acts as a black-box backdoor (`Sleek`) to reconstruct superficially erased facts across direct, implied, and indirect multi-step prompts.

papers.title: R-TOFU: Unlearning in Large Reasoning Models
papers.summary: Establishes the first LRM unlearning benchmark with aligned CoT annotations and step-wise metrics (`CFE`, `AFE`), proposes `Reasoned IDK` preference tuning, and uncovers `ZeroThink`/`LessThink` decoding leakage.

papers.title: Measuring Chain of Thought Faithfulness by Unlearning Reasoning Steps
papers.summary: Erases parametric knowledge encoded in individual CoT steps via KL-regularized NPO (`FUR`) and measures resulting prediction shifts (`ff-hard`, `ff-soft`) to test parametric CoT faithfulness.

papers.title: UnStar: Unlearning with Self-Taught Anti-Sample Reasoning for LLMs
papers.summary: Pioneers self-taught anti-sample reasoning—generating falsified answers backed by misleading step-by-step rationales—to selectively reverse target parametric associations without harming neighboring facts.
